$comment: reflux's profile over accrete's vocabulary: selection, channels, defaults, and the class-token vocabulary.
It holds NO type definitions — the types come from schema/accrete.schema.json and nowhere else.
Read by tools/gen_sdk.py (builders + gates) and, at runtime, by reflux/sdk/profile.py.
positional:  what the first positional argument of ui.<type>() means — `children` (the child nodes)
or `value` (a static value: the display/data payload the renderer reads). null = none.
children:    the builder takes *children.  item: the builder takes item= (the wire's `item` template).
channels:    the two directions of a value (ADR 0031 §2), what the builder offers beside attrs/id:
`source` is where the value comes from, `sink` is where it goes. Each accepts a Source (read) or a Sink (write)
(ADR 0039: a read carries slot/scope/path/default, a write dest/scope/path) or a bare value: a bare value on a
read (source) is a constant — {"default": <value>} — and on a write (sink) a `dest` name.
`default` says a bare constant is a legal source for this type (a frame has none: a
frame's source is always an address, never a literal), and it is what makes the
positional `value` a constant source rather than a shape error.
`false`/absent means the renderer does not read or write that direction for this type,
so the builder offers no keyword for it — a channel a type does not accept is a frame
error on the wire, and an uncallable keyword on this side. Verified in ui_leptos.
values:      the node's own named second values (select.options, input.placeholder):
not channels — each is one named field of its type, and takes the same Bind-or-value.
selector:    a name the renderer addresses a node by, and pure data here: an `entry`'s field is
named by its child's `attrs.selector`, and a `tiles` header/field by theirs. That is
why `selector` is a builder keyword — the wire would otherwise have no way to say a
field's name. `class` stays hidden: the token lane is the only path to a class.
submit:      a bundle's timing (ADR 0032) is a plain attribute, not a channel: `enter|button|change`,
a bare string or a list on the wire, absent = [enter]. The builder takes either spelling.
tokens:      enum value -> class token, filled in when the styling layer lands (M1). Until then the
builders offer no class strings at all — the producer cannot reach a free class.

stamp.why: the renderer instantiates it by name (a substitution node), not something a producer draws
